title: 第19章 再见上官秋月第20章 老父亲的欣慰儿子终于出息了
content_zh:
一眨眼三天过去。
这是许小凡这段日子以来，过的最安稳的几天。
没有人莫名其妙看他不顺眼。
更没有杨家花家过来寻仇。
他所要做的，就是老老实实待在房间里修炼。
然后等待逐鹿院招生的日子到来。
如果可以，他希望这样的日子可以持续的长一点。
可，第三天的上午，来了一个不速之客。
没错，就是那个可恶的六皇子。
如果给他讨厌的人排一个名单。
那么这个名单上，李宝这个名字，一定排在最前面。
所以在开门的时候，许小凡的脸色很不好看。
他冷冷说道：“什么事？”
李宝浑不在意，脸上挂着笑道：“许前辈可在，我有要事相商。”
许小凡撇了撇嘴，“跟我来吧。”
走过曲折游廊，踏过小石路，在临到院子前，李宝才继续开口道：
“小凡兄，在下也并不是有意欺骗的，当时其实是想救你，但没有赶上。”
许小凡冷哼一声道：
“无需多言。
我并不想和你有太多瓜葛。

我就想当一个老实人而已，皇权之争，不想参与。”
李宝无奈道：
“小凡兄，咱们终究是一条船上的。
我们与杨家都是敌人。
即便你与我关系不好，却也改变不了什么。
这就是立场，不会因为个人喜恶而发生变化。”
许小凡语气平静下来，开口道：
“我自然知道，这一点不用你提醒，我就是单纯看你不爽而已。”
李宝沉默。
就在这良久的沉默中，二人已经来到前院。
就见许渊此刻正坐在一棵大槐树下，闭目打坐。
李宝感叹道：“前辈平日里修行都这么刻苦的吗？”
许小凡道：“废寝忘食，日夜不辍。”
李宝想到自己有点羞愧，“果然，强是有道理的！”
这个时候，许渊已经睁开眼，看向李宝问道：
“什么事？”
李宝从怀里拿出一份请帖，恭恭敬敬递上去道：
“前辈，这是陛下八十大寿的邀请函，如果前辈有兴趣，可带着小凡兄弟一起去参加。”
一边，许小凡有点吃惊，“皇帝有八十岁了？”
李宝笑着道：“驻颜有术。”

许小凡咂咂嘴...有钱就是好！
这时许渊笑着说：“我就不去了，小凡，你去吧。”
许小凡连忙摇头道：“别，我可不去！”
content_en:
Three days passed in the blink of an eye.
This was the most stable few days that Xu Xiaofan had ever had.
No one disliked him for some reason.
Not to mention the Yang family and the Hua family came to seek revenge.
All he had to do was stay in the room and practice.
Then wait for the enrollment day of Zhuluyuan to arrive.
If possible, he hoped that such days could last longer.
But, on the morning of the third day, an uninvited guest came.
That's right, it's that damn sixth prince.
What if he made a list of people he hates.
So on this list, the name Li Bao must be at the top.
So when he opened the door, Xu Xiaofan's face looked very ugly.
He said coldly: "What's the matter?"
Li Baohun didn't care, and said with a smile on his face: "Senior Xu is here, I have something important to discuss."
Xu Xiaofan curled his lips and said, "Come with me."
After walking through the winding verandah and stepping on the small stone path, before arriving at the courtyard, Li Baocai continued:
"Brother Xiaofan, I didn't mean to deceive you. I actually wanted to save you, but I didn't catch up."
Xu Xiaofan snorted coldly and said:
"No need to say anything.
I don't want to have much to do with you.
I just want to be an honest person and don't want to participate in the struggle for imperial power. "
Li Bao said helplessly:
"Brother Xiaofan, we are in the same boat after all.
We and the Yang family are both enemies.
Even if you have a bad relationship with me, it won't change anything.
This is our position and it will not change based on personal likes and dislikes. "
Xu Xiaofan calmed down and said:
"Of course I know. You don't need to remind me of this. I just see that you are unhappy."
Li Bao was silent.
In this long silence, the two of them had arrived in the front yard.
I saw Xu Yuan sitting under a big locust tree at this moment, meditating with his eyes closed.
Li Bao sighed: "Senior, do you practice so hard in daily life?"
Xu Xiaofan said: "I forget to eat and sleep, day and night."
Li Bao thought that he was a little ashamed, "Sure enough, being strong makes sense!"
At this time, Xu Yuan had already opened his eyes, looked at Li Bao and asked:
"What's the matter?"
Li Bao took out an invitation from his arms, handed it to him respectfully and said:
"Senior, this is an invitation letter for His Majesty's eightieth birthday. If senior is interested, you can take Brother Xiaofan to attend."
On the other hand, Xu Xiaofan was a little surprised, "The emperor is eighty years old?"
Li Bao smiled and said: "There is a way to maintain your appearance."
Xu Xiaofan smacked his lips... Having money is good!
At this time Xu Yuan smiled and said: "I won't go, Xiaofan, you go."
Xu Xiaofan quickly shook his head and said: "No, I won't go!"
